content.short: Latin American crypto app and exchange, also issuing local-currency stablecoins.
content.description: Ripio has been operating in Latin America for over a decade, offering a crypto app for buying, selling and holding digital assets, an exchange, and crypto infrastructure for businesses. It issues local stablecoins for the region and incubated CapyFi through Ripio Ventures. It serves users in countries including Argentina, Brazil, Mexico and Colombia.
content.meta: Ripio runs a leading Latin American crypto app and exchange, with local-currency stablecoins and business infrastructure.
